title: Hong Kong Mahjong, Chicken hand
summary: 13-tile Hong Kong Mahjong, chicken-hand rules. The same as HKMA Classical (cap 10, the discarder pays the whole hand, flowers do not score, no Seven Pairs) except that the minimum is 0 faan: a complete hand with no scoring pattern may win, and pays the 0-faan row. RULES.md has the full table.
source_profile: hkma_classical_v1 with a minimum of 0 faan
field_note: The same three scripted bots as hk-hkma-v1, which read only their own seat view. They take a win whenever the engine offers one, so on this table they declare a chicken hand, and they read the table's rules, so what counts as a ready hand moves with the minimum. The scored bot takes one seat and the field fills the other three in this order, starting with the seat after the scored bot.

seeds.private: The scored deck is private. Give its path with --private-seeds or the HKBENCH_PRIVATE_SEEDS environment variable. It must not overlap the public range.

schedule: deal i has dealer i % 4 and prevailing wind (i // 4) % 4; every deal is played four times, the scored bot taking each seat once
